title: mixcore core API v0.5: result of Gesture(commandJSON)
description: Gesture takes the same command as Apply, enforces the same rules, and answers at once what the core did (CR-22): the UI draws the core's value and state instead of assuming its candidate was applied, and plays the haptic from state. On an error code (ERR_NEEDS_CONFIRM, ERR_SHOW_MODE, ERR_GAIN_BOUND, ...) there is no result.

state.description: free: applied as asked. atWall: deprecated in v0.5, never sent (slip guard retired, CC-1); removed in v0.6. atCap: Gain at a range end of its headamp (minDB or writeMaxDB, v0.5 CC-2; rigid haptic). atCeiling: stopped at the monitor ceiling ('Max set by your engineer'; never opens). locked: show mode stopped a Gain raise ('Raising Gain is locked in show mode').

value.description: The value the core applied (set, openWall) or the start (holdBegin). For set it may differ from the command's value.

written.description: A write left for the console (false for holdBegin, holdEnd, openWall, settings and a set that changed nothing).

window.description: The active gesture window (holdBegin, set within a hold, openWall). Absent outside a hold.

wallUpDB.description: Deprecated in v0.5: never sent (slip guard retired); removed in v0.6.

capUpDB.description: Gain: the top of the headamp's range a write may reach (writeMaxDB), never below the start (v0.5; v0.3 had start + 3 dB).

capDownDB.description: Gain: the bottom of the headamp's range (minDB) (v0.5; v0.3 had start - 6 dB).

ceilingDB.description: Monitor ceiling: engineer's latest value + headroom.

opensByRest.description: Deprecated in v0.5: always false (no wall opens by rest any more); removed in v0.6.

pinRecord.description: v0.5, lockShowMode only: the hashed PIN record to store with this console's settings and pass back in config safety.showModeLock.pinRecord (README rule 16). Only Gesture returns it; Apply drops it. Never shown to the user.
